mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_event_consumption WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND event_type = #{eventType} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_event_consumption SET status = 'PROCESSING', processing_owner = #{owner}, processing_until = #{until}, consume_count = consume_count + 1, last_received_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND (status IN ('FAILED', 'REPLAYING') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_until < #{now}))

UPDATE payment_event_consumption SET status = 'FAILED', failure_type = #{failureType}, last_error = #{error}, last_received_at = #{now}, processing_owner = NULL, processing_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_owner = #{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_event_consumption WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY last_received_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_event_consumption SET status = 'REPLAYING', last_received_at = #{now}, processing_owner = NULL, processing_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED' AND (failure_type IS NULL OR failure_type != 'CONFLICT')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_event_replay_audit (event_id, operator, reason, request_id, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{operator}, #{reason}, #{requestId}, #{createdAt})
